args: Authorize ONLY vertical_pregrasp. Assess the actual open hand swept path to this pad-center target and orientation, including fingers and nearby bowl, bottle, stove and cabinet. The high alignment stays at current altitude; vertical_pregrasp stops 65 mm above the package top. Do not require retention or later bowl fit. Confirm the measured package has not moved. Unknown is not clear.

geometry.aperture_assumption: Symmetric prismatic joint separation less one transverse pad-size allowance is a conservative screening model, not measured inner-face clearance; fresh visible straddling is also required.
geometry.p0_identity: White curled capital C beginning Cream near the upper end of the printed blue logo.
geometry.geometry_scope: Original same-frame upper boundary and planes, independently checked local top/support samples, and a new lower grasp target; actual pose margins must pass before closure.

result.explanation: Clear for vertical_pregrasp only. Using the current open-finger bounds and target orientation, the lowest finger surface stops near 0.970 m: approximately 51 mm above the package top and 19 mm above the measured bowl rim. The visible hand housing remains higher. The bottle and cabinet are laterally outside this descent; the stove is below and outside it. No external obstruction is visible in this local sweep. The package outline, logo and position relative to neighboring objects match the earlier fixed-camera image.

parameters.notes: Authorization covers only descent to pad center [-0.0532806, 0.144382, 0.982985] with the stated orientation and open hand, including the small remaining alignment correction. It does not authorize lower descent, closure or transfer. Package agreement is within image resolution, not a new submillimeter pose measurement. Current package, support and obstacle selections are returned for fresh measurement. Wrist-image bottom occlusion is robot self-occlusion; the agentview exposes the relevant neighboring surfaces. No hidden-surface or global clearance certificate is claimed.
